endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: id_blm_island_bar_recreation_site blm-island-bar-recreation-site: BLM publishes the Island Bar site coordinate and identifies this undeveloped Lower Salmon recreation site as a frequent put-in with easy river access. Keep the point as a recreation-site/access anchor; it does not identify a surveyed shoreline landing or ramp toe. Verify current site and beach conditions.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (id_blm_island_bar_recreation_site blm-island-bar-recreation-site) on Salmon River / Lower Salmon River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.

endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: id_blm_shorts_bar_recreation_site_20260918 blm-idaho-shorts-bar-recreation-site: The BLM's current Shorts Bar Recreation Site page identifies the public site as a frequent put-in for the Lower Salmon River, describes easy access to the river, and publishes 45.41194444,-116.3022222, which rounds to the stored route point. The official BLM Lower Salmon boater guide identifies Shorts Bar as a BLM recreation site with toilets, a boat ramp, and campsites; a BLM announcement confirms ramp upgrades at Shorts Bar. This establishes the access facility and the appropriate access-area pin, not a separately surveyed wet toe.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (id_blm_shorts_bar_recreation_site_20260918 blm-idaho-shorts-bar-recreation-site) on Salmon River / Lower Salmon River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.
